Nov 1.2023

ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION I. Title 17, of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning
Ordinance be amended by changing all the RS3 Residential Single-Unit (Detached

House) District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 3-M in the area

bounded by

A line 178.50 feet south of and parallel to West Division Street; the alley
next east of and parallel to North Austin Boulevard; a line 208.50 feet
south of and parallel to West Division Street; and North Austin Boulevard,

to those of an RT3.5 Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage

and due publication.

Common Address of Property: 1141 North Austin Boulevard
